verdict.rationale: Asaas documents a single account-level API key sent in the access_token header, plus advice to restrict authorized IPs. IP allowlisting is an adjacent network control, not a permission-scoped credential, and subaccounts are a separate account-structure feature. Nothing in the pack shows issuing keys limited by scope, resource, or permission for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
